context: Two teens trade pep-talks before a club tryout
purpose: Teach: ひとこと/おいら/ポジティブ/多彩/過言/漠然と/心境/好感

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、緊張してる？今の正直な心境、聞かせてよ。
lines.en: Riku, are you nervous? Tell me your honest feelings right now.
lines.style: Warm and probing, a supportive friend checking in gently.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うーん、漠然とした不安はあるけど、おいらは大丈夫だと思う。
lines.en: Hmm, I've got some vague anxiety, but I think I'll be fine.
lines.style: Boyish bravado tinged with honest teenage uncertainty.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: そういう時こそポジティブにいこ！リクなら受かるって言っても過言じゃないし。
lines.en: Times like this, go positive! Saying you'll pass isn't even an exaggeration.
lines.style: Cheerleader energy, confident and bright with conviction.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: サクラの多彩な特技を見てる先輩たちも、絶対好感持ってるはずだしね。
lines.en: The seniors who've seen all your varied talents are bound to like you too.
lines.style: Returning the compliment with sincere admiration between friends.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ありがと。じゃあひとこと、お互いに気合い入れとこっか。
lines.en: Thanks. Then let's psych each other up with one word each.
lines.style: Light, playful invitation to a small ritual between friends.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: おう、おいらから言うぞ。サクラなら絶対いける！
lines.en: Sure, I'll go first. Sakura, you've totally got this!
lines.style: Enthusiastic shout, full of brotherly encouragement and warmth.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リクも自分を信じて。ここまで頑張ってきたんだから。
lines.en: You believe in yourself too, Riku. You've worked so hard until now.
lines.style: Quiet, heartfelt reassurance with steady eye contact.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん、行ってくる！この気持ち、絶対忘れないようにしないと。
lines.en: Yeah, I'm heading in! I definitely don't want to forget this feeling.
lines.style: Determined exit line, charged with youthful resolve and grit.
